subject: GD Task 15 output - 3rd wrong attempt state diagram
body:
GD TASK 15 - WRONG ANSWER 3RD ATTEMPT ERROR STATE SPEC
State diagram as text.

STATES
S0: Question loaded, unanswered. Hint button visible.
S1: Answered correctly. Green feedback. Next question CTA.
S2: Answered wrong, attempt 1. Red feedback. Try again button. Hint still available but not expanded.
S3: Answered wrong, attempt 2. Red feedback. Try again + stronger hint nudge. Hint button pulses once.
S4: Answered wrong, attempt 3 (TRIGGER STATE). Red feedback. Auto-expand hint layer 1. Show solution steps button. Show correct answer button. Try again still present.
S5: Hint expanded in S4. Hint layer 1 visible. Solution steps visible. Correct answer visible.
S6: Graded (submit pressed). Question shows final state (correct or incorrect). No more input.

TRANSITIONS
S0 -> S1: correct answer submitted
S0 -> S2: wrong answer submitted (attempt 1)
S2 -> S1: correct answer submitted
S2 -> S3: wrong answer submitted (attempt 2)
S3 -> S1: correct answer submitted
S3 -> S4: wrong answer submitted (attempt 3)
S4 -> S1: correct answer submitted (still allowed)
S4/S5 -> S5: Kai clicks Show Answer or Solution Steps
All states -> S6: submit button pressed

ADHD DESIGN RULES FOR S4
1. Do not add shame copy. Not: You got it wrong 3 times. Do: redirect.
2. Auto-expand hint layer 1 (do not make Kai find the hint button). S4 is a cognitive rescue.
3. Copy in S4: Off target - check the hint below. Next action is obvious.
4. Correct answer button in S4: shows the answer in place. Kai can self-check. Not auto-shown - requires a tap.
5. Focus: when entering S4, scroll to hint layer and focus it. Kai may have tabbed away.

COPY (S4 state)
Red feedback div: Off target. Check the hint below.
Hint expanded: [hint text - already in JSON per question]
Button 1: Show Answer (reveals correct answer inline)
Button 2: Show Solution Steps (reveals step-by-step)
Button 3: Try Again (clears input, keeps S4 UI)

CURRENT STATE
exam.html has hint layers (hint-layers div, hint-btn). No attempt counter. No auto-expand on 3rd wrong.
GA implementation needs: (1) attempt counter per question id, (2) check counter in grading loop, (3) trigger auto-expand on count===3.

ACCEPT CRITERIA
- 3 wrong answers on same question: hint auto-expands, solution steps visible, correct answer button visible
- Fewer than 3 wrong: hint stays collapsed
- Grading still works correctly regardless of hint state
- Mobile: scrolls to hint on S4 entry
- Reduced-motion: no scroll animation, instant jump
